why: Full chains are declared HERE, one entry per project, because no project declares them as a set: each keeps its scripts in its own package.json (b100-am-ui: build:ci-pr, ci:test, check:mutation, check:a11y, test:all-coverage; Discovery-FE: build:ci, build:ci-pr, test:all, test:coverage:ci) and the selftest runners live in this repository. A script not listed here is not a full chain. A command that runs a declared chain inside it (worktree-landing/land.mjs runs the selftest runner; .claude/integrate/integrate.mjs runs build:ci-pr's steps and the selftest runner) is declared too, because the guard sees only the command line it is given. @es Las cadenas completas se declaran AQUI, una entrada por proyecto, porque ningun proyecto las declara como conjunto: cada uno guarda sus scripts en su package.json y los runners de selftests viven en este repositorio. Un script que no esta aqui no es una cadena completa. Un comando que corre por dentro una cadena declarada (worktree-landing/land.mjs corre el runner de selftests; .claude/integrate/integrate.mjs corre los pasos de build:ci-pr y el runner) tambien se declara, porque el guard solo ve la linea de comando que recibe.
